personality_one_liner: Clean, authoritative, and focused entirely on the outdoor rental experience, letting the bikes and imagery take center stage.

spacing.rule: Generous spacing. Use safe-area for every top-level screen. Use 'md' (12px) or 'lg' (16px) for card padding, 'xl' (24px) for screen margins.

do's: Use on sticky bottom CTA bars (e.g., booking confirmation bar)
Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
dont's: Do not use on generic form fields or regular list items

screens.name: Home / Catalog
screens.purpose: Discover and browse available bikes by category.

states.empty: Illustration/Icon with 'Nessuna bici trovata' and 'Ricarica' button.

screens.layout: Header with 'Noleggio Nuovo' and User avatar. Horizontal scroll for categories (Tutte, Gravel, E-bike, Gravel muscolare). Vertical list of bike cards. Each card: edge-to-edge image in a rounded container, name, tags for size (S/M/L/XL), and price per hour/day.

screens.name: Bike Detail & Booking
screens.purpose: View bike details, select size, date, time slot, and book.
screens.layout: Large hero image with gradient-to-dark scrim. Scrollable content: Bike Name, Category, Description. Size Selector: Segmented controls (S, M, L, XL) showing height ranges (e.g., 'S: 155-165cm'). Date/Time picker. Sticky bottom CTA 'Prenota Ora' using glassmorphism.

screens.name: Payment / Checkout
screens.purpose: Confirm booking details and choose payment method.

states.error: Payment failed state with Retry button.

screens.layout: Summary card of the booking (Bike, Dates, Total). Payment options: 'Paga ora (Stripe)' or 'Paga in negozio'. Bottom sticky CTA 'Conferma prenotazione'.

screens.name: Admin Dashboard
screens.layout: Tabs or segmented control for 'Bici' and 'Prenotazioni'. List views for easy management. FAB to add new bike.

onboarding_or_hero.alt: Cyclist riding a road bike through a forest

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the color palette provided. Do not use any blues, purples, or unlisted colors.
Implement the 'iOS-Native Clean' personality: prioritize typography, high-quality images, and whitespace. Do not clutter the UI.
For all primary CTAs, use 'brandPrimary' with 'onBrandPrimary' text. Ensure they are sticky at the bottom with a safe-area clearance.
When displaying images as headers or cards with text overlays, you MUST apply a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee readability.
For the size selector, use rounded segmented controls or chips clearly showing S, M, L, XL with their corresponding height ranges.
Use Ionicons. Keep icons consistent (either all outlined or all filled, except in the tab bar where active is filled and inactive is outlined).
Ensure glassmorphism (via expo-blur) is used on the sticky bottom booking bar and bottom tab bar, over a tinted background for clarity.
Add haptics (via expo-haptics) to all primary button presses, tab switches, and segmented control selections.
